number: 第二百四十八条の四の三十四
summary_ja: 将来エクスポージャーはシミュレーションで生成したパスに基づく将来のエクスポージャーの現在価値とし、計測要件、会計CVAとの整合、ネッティングの扱いを定める。
summary_en: Future exposure is the present value of exposures from simulated paths; the article sets measurement requirements, consistency with accounting CVA, and the treatment of netting.
paragraphs: The "future exposure" listed in item (iii) of paragraph (2) of Article 248-4-31 means future exposure obtained using paths generated by simulation, discounted to present value.

The measurement of future exposure (meaning the future exposure provided in the preceding paragraph; the same applies hereinafter in this Subsection) shall satisfy all of the following requirements. (i) It shall be constructed by valuing all derivative transactions with the counterparty on the basis of paths generated by simulating the relevant market risk factors (meaning the categories of causes, such as interest rates, that affect the prices of the transactions subject to the calculation of the CVA risk equivalent amount; the same applies in this paragraph and Article 248-4-38, paragraph (4), item (iii)), and discounting to the present time using the risk-free rate. (ii) All market risk factors that are material in transactions with the counterparty shall be simulated using stochastic processes so as to generate an appropriate number of paths at appropriate points in time over the period of the transaction with the longest maturity. (iii) For transactions that are highly correlated with the creditworthiness of the counterparty, that correlation shall be taken into account. (iv) The drift of the risk factors (meaning the average direction of a random variable per unit of time; the same applies hereinafter in this item) shall be determined under the risk-neutral measure; provided, however, that calibration of the level of the drift based on historical data shall not be permitted. (v) The volatilities and correlation coefficients of market risk factors shall be calibrated using market data where sufficient market data exist; provided, however, that where sufficient market data do not exist, calibration based on historical data shall be permitted. (vi) The distribution of the modeled risk factors shall take into account the possibility that the distribution of future exposure is not a normal distribution (including the possibility of fat tails).

Future exposure shall be measured based on the model used by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company to measure accounting CVA. In this case, where the accounting CVA does not satisfy the CVA measurement method provided in this Division, the necessary adjustments shall be made.

The following elements used in measuring future exposure shall be the same as those used in measuring accounting CVA. (i) The model calibration process, excluding the margin period of risk. (ii) The market data and actual transaction data used in calculating CVA.
The recognition of netting shall be the same as the treatment in the measurement of accounting CVA, and the uncertainty of netting shall be taken into account in the measurement of CVA.
